defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Aluum Antimagic
offensiveAbilities.description: Aluum enforcers are immune to spells and magical abilities, with two exceptions. A void spell or magical ability grants an aluum enforcer the Quickened condition until the end of its next turn instead of its normal effects. A vitality spell or ability makes an aluum enforcer Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn instead of its normal effects.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralyzing Force
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature damaged by the aluum enforcer's fist Strike must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed for 1 round. On a critical failure, the creature is paralyzed for 1d4 minutes and falls Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Soul Shriek
offensiveAbilities.description:
The aluum enforcer emits a keening wail in a 15ft Cone that deals 9d6 Sonic Damage damage (Basic DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw save). A creature that fails its save is Stunned 1, or Stunned 3 on a critical failure.

The aluum can't use Soul Shriek again for 1d4 rounds.
